CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, August 21, 2019 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room A

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco-Chan, President
  Karsen Luthi, Vice President
  Michael Lawrence
  Camille Rutkowski
  Aide Zeller

 II.  FLAG SALUTE

III.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE JUNE 19, 2019 REGULAR MEETING

IV.  STAFF REPORT
  Update on Alhambra Entry Signs
  Update on Latino Heritage Festival/Chalk Art Contest

 V.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VI.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
during office hours: 8:00. A.M. to 5:00 P.M. Monday through Friday. Should any person have a question concerning any of
the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or in
the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
minutes_text:
Unofficial until adopted by the  October 16, 2019
City Arts and Cultural Events Committee

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  Wednesday, August 21, 2019 7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee was called to order at 7:03
P.M. on Wednesday August 21, 2019 at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street Alhambra,
Conference Room A.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: Canseco Chan, Luthi, Lawrence, Rutkowski, and Zeller.
Committee Members Absent: None
Also attending: Deputy Director Brie Houghton and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE JUNE 19, 2019 MEETING
On the motion of Vice President Luthi with a second by Lawrence, the minutes of the June 19,
2019 City Arts and Cultural Events Committee Meeting were unanimously approved as written.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton informed the committee that quotes for the Alhambra Entry Signs
Restoration Project were received and a vendor was awarded. The vendor will not start work for
another week because the City will need to submit a 50% deposit at the start of work. Staff’s
goal is to have all three Alhambra Entry Signs completed by October 2019.

Michael Lawrence would like to be notified when the Alhambra Entry Signs Restoration Project
begins so that the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee could be present for a photograph.
Deputy Director Houghton will speak with Alhambra City Clerk in regards to the Brown Act and
see if it is possible for the committee to do so.

Next item discussed was the Latino Heritage/Chalk Art Contest by Deputy Director Houghton.
Houghton explain that posts were made on the official City social media accounts and double-
sided flyers were printed for extra event publicity. Vice President Luthi said he received fifteen
entries and talked to Mr. Jason Pineda, an Art Instructor from Alhambra High School, about
involving the Alhambra High School students.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Lawrence requested the committee to come to the next meeting prepared with a project idea to
discuss. Zeller would like to get the students of Alhambra involved with art projects such as the
Utility Boxes. Canseco-Chan has been working with the Huntington Library archives to see if
there are photographs of Alhambra. He would like to have a permanent art installation that
 highlights the history of the train passing through Alhambra showing the contributions from
multiple ethnic groups. Canseco-Chan advises the committee to look into local nonprofits that
would do auctions, pro bono work, and would be willing to fund the City of Alhambra’s art each
year since the City of Alhambra Art Budget is limited.

ADJOURNMENT
Committee Member Rutkowski moved to adjourn the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee
Meeting. Seconded by Committee Member Aide, the meeting was adjourned at 8:07 P.M.
